S03-the-kettle-and-coal.md.quote: She tells her about debts that were paid off in one year and borrowed again in the next.

S03-the-kettle-and-coal.md.subject: Mother Brisk
S03-the-kettle-and-coal.md.statement: Mother Brisk says men have started going up the road at night to look at the old mine.
S03-the-kettle-and-coal.md.quote: the men who have started going up the road at night to look at it

S03-the-kettle-and-coal.md.subject: Odo
S03-the-kettle-and-coal.md.statement: Odo will not look at people when he talks, according to Mother Brisk.
S03-the-kettle-and-coal.md.quote: Won't look at you when he talks.

S03-the-kettle-and-coal.md.subject: Ves
S03-the-kettle-and-coal.md.statement: Ves watches the light on the wet cobbles of Saltgate from the window.
S03-the-kettle-and-coal.md.quote: She watches the light on Saltgate's wet cobbles until she can no longer tell it from the reflection of her own face.

S04-embers-and-oaths.md.subject: Ysolde
S04-embers-and-oaths.md.statement: Ysolde asks Corin to leave the Cinder Bridge open after dusk.
S04-embers-and-oaths.md.quote: Ysolde asks Corin to leave the Cinder Bridge open after dusk, just once.

S04-embers-and-oaths.md.subject: Ysolde
S04-embers-and-oaths.md.statement: Ysolde finds Corin at the foot of the Bell Gate tower.

S04-embers-and-oaths.md.subject: Corin
S04-embers-and-oaths.md.statement: Corin tells Ysolde that the bridge closes when the bell rings.
S04-embers-and-oaths.md.quote: "The bridge closes when the bell rings," Corin says.

S04-embers-and-oaths.md.subject: Corin
S04-embers-and-oaths.md.statement: Corin refuses Ysolde's request to keep the bridge open.

S04-embers-and-oaths.md.subject: Ysolde
S04-embers-and-oaths.md.statement: Ysolde hooks her arm through Ves's and walks with her down Kiln Street.
S04-embers-and-oaths.md.quote: hooks her arm through Ves's before she can refuse

S04-embers-and-oaths.md.subject: Ysolde
S04-embers-and-oaths.md.statement: Ysolde answers Ves's question about the wagons by talking about lamp oil.
S04-embers-and-oaths.md.quote: Ysolde talks about the price of lamp oil instead.

S04-embers-and-oaths.md.subject: Ves
S04-embers-and-oaths.md.statement: Ves watches Corin and Ysolde argue from the edge of the shade.
S04-embers-and-oaths.md.quote: Ves watches them from the edge of the shade.

S04-embers-and-oaths.md.subject: Ysolde
S04-embers-and-oaths.md.statement: Ysolde sends a small boy running with a coin and a private message near Saltgate.
S04-embers-and-oaths.md.quote: Near Saltgate she sends a small boy running with a coin and a message she does not share.

S04-embers-and-oaths.md.subject: Ysolde
S04-embers-and-oaths.md.statement: Ysolde climbs back up the hill toward the Bell Gate.
S04-embers-and-oaths.md.quote: climbs back up the hill with her hands buried in her coat

S05-the-silent-bell.md.subject: Ashbell
S05-the-silent-bell.md.statement: The Ashbell makes no sound at dusk on Day 2.
S05-the-silent-bell.md.quote: At dusk on Day 2, the Ashbell swings but makes no sound at all.

S05-the-silent-bell.md.subject: Rourke
S05-the-silent-bell.md.statement: Captain Rourke stands watch at the Bell Gate from 21:00 to 22:00 on Day 2.
S05-the-silent-bell.md.quote: From 21:00 to 22:00 on Day 2, Captain Rourke stands watch at the Bell Gate and sees no one climb the tower.

S05-the-silent-bell.md.subject: Corin
S05-the-silent-bell.md.statement: Corin climbs the tower stair of the Bell Gate to ring the bell.
S05-the-silent-bell.md.quote: Corin climbs the tower stair two steps at a time.

S05-the-silent-bell.md.subject: Ves
S05-the-silent-bell.md.statement: Ves follows Corin back down the tower stairs.
S05-the-silent-bell.md.quote: Ves follows him back down the stairs.

S05-the-silent-bell.md.subject: Rourke
S05-the-silent-bell.md.statement: Rourke says that nobody climbed the tower while he was watching it.
S05-the-silent-bell.md.quote: "I was watching the tower all night," Rourke says.

S05-the-silent-bell.md.subject: Corin
S05-the-silent-bell.md.statement: Corin asks Ves to walk where the guards cannot and find the thief.
S05-the-silent-bell.md.quote: I need someone who can walk where the guards cannot.

S05-the-silent-bell.md.subject: Corin
S05-the-silent-bell.md.statement: Corin tells Ves she is the only one who will not ask him for permission.
S05-the-silent-bell.md.quote: Because you are the only one who will not ask me for permission.

S05-the-silent-bell.md.subject: Ysolde
S05-the-silent-bell.md.statement: Ysolde is not in the crowd at the Bell Gate after the bell fails.
S05-the-silent-bell.md.quote: Ysolde is nowhere in the crowd.

S05-the-silent-bell.md.subject: Ves
S05-the-silent-bell.md.statement: Ves stands among the crowd at the foot of the Bell Gate.
S05-the-silent-bell.md.quote: Ves stands among them with her hands in her pockets

S06-lamps-along-kiln-street.md.subject: Rourke
S06-lamps-along-kiln-street.md.statement: Captain Rourke is at the Kettle & Coal at 21:30 on Day 2.
S06-lamps-along-kiln-street.md.quote: At 21:30 on Day 2, Captain Rourke is drinking alone at the Kettle & Coal.

S06-lamps-along-kiln-street.md.subject: Lamplighter
S06-lamps-along-kiln-street.md.statement: The Lamplighter is on the Cinder Bridge at 22:00 on Day 2.
S06-lamps-along-kiln-street.md.quote: At 22:00 on Day 2, the Lamplighter is on the Cinder Bridge, trimming the last wick.

S06-lamps-along-kiln-street.md.subject: Ves
S06-lamps-along-kiln-street.md.statement: Ves walks along Kiln Street at night, asking people about the bell.
S06-lamps-along-kiln-street.md.quote: Ves walks Kiln Street with her collar up

S06-lamps-along-kiln-street.md.subject: Ves
S06-lamps-along-kiln-street.md.statement: Ves asks people quietly who was out at dusk.

S06-lamps-along-kiln-street.md.subject: Ves
S06-lamps-along-kiln-street.md.statement: Most people refuse to answer Ves when she asks about the bell.
S06-lamps-along-kiln-street.md.quote: Most people shake their heads or shut their doors.

S06-lamps-along-kiln-street.md.subject: Ves
S06-lamps-along-kiln-street.md.statement: Ves reaches the Cinder Bridge at the place where it leaves Kiln Street.
S06-lamps-along-kiln-street.md.quote: Ves reaches the Cinder Bridge a short while later

S06-lamps-along-kiln-street.md.subject: Ves
S06-lamps-along-kiln-street.md.statement: Ves decides not to interrupt Rourke while he is drinking.
S06-lamps-along-kiln-street.md.quote: He will not thank her for interrupting his drink.

S06-lamps-along-kiln-street.md.subject: Ves
S06-lamps-along-kiln-street.md.statement: Ves turns back toward the lamps on Kiln Street.
S06-lamps-along-kiln-street.md.quote: She turns back toward the lamps on Kiln Street

S07-the-ember-well.md.subject: Ves
S07-the-ember-well.md.statement: Ves is at the Ember Well at 05:00 on Day 3.
S07-the-ember-well.md.quote: At 05:00 on Day 3, Ves kneels at the Ember Well and drinks before the sky turns grey.

S07-the-ember-well.md.subject: Ves
S07-the-ember-well.md.statement: Ves gains Ashsight at the Ember Well.
S07-the-ember-well.md.quote: The water burns going down, and when Ves opens her eyes she has Ashsight.

S07-the-ember-well.md.subject: Hesper
S07-the-ember-well.md.statement: Hesper gives Ves the Cinder Key.
S07-the-ember-well.md.quote: Abbess Hesper Quill gives Ves the Cinder Key and tells her to bring it back before the bell rings again.

S07-the-ember-well.md.subject: Ves
S07-the-ember-well.md.statement: Ves enters Stillfire Abbey through its side door.
S07-the-ember-well.md.quote: Sister Agnet unbars the side door of Stillfire Abbey and lets Ves in without a word.

S07-the-ember-well.md.subject: Hesper
S07-the-ember-well.md.statement: Hesper tests Ves with a single question about Aldous Ashdown.
S07-the-ember-well.md.quote: Hesper tests Ves with a single question about Aldous Ashdown.

S07-the-ember-well.md.subject: Ves
S07-the-ember-well.md.statement: Ves remembers Aldous Ashdown as a tall man with a cough.
S07-the-ember-well.md.quote: Ves remembers Aldous Ashdown only as a tall man with a cough and a laugh that carried across the market.

S07-the-ember-well.md.subject: Ves
S07-the-ember-well.md.statement: Ves drinks warm water from the Ember Well.
S07-the-ember-well.md.quote: She cups it in both hands and drinks until her throat is raw.

S07-the-ember-well.md.subject: Ves
S07-the-ember-well.md.statement: Ves holds the Cinder Key in her hand.
S07-the-ember-well.md.quote: Ves closes her hand around the Cinder Key, warm as a coal

S07-the-ember-well.md.subject: Hesper
S07-the-ember-well.md.statement: Hesper watches Ves closely as she takes the key.
S07-the-ember-well.md.quote: Hesper watches Ves over the rim of her cup and waits for an answer she has not asked for.

S08-tracks-in-the-ash.md.subject: Tamsin
S08-tracks-in-the-ash.md.statement: Tamsin is at the Cinder Bridge at 09:00 on Day 3.
S08-tracks-in-the-ash.md.quote: At 09:00 on Day 3, Tamsin is waiting at the Cinder Bridge with a message from the Abbey.

S08-tracks-in-the-ash.md.subject: Ves
S08-tracks-in-the-ash.md.statement: Ves follows the heat trail from the Bell Gate toward the Old Mine.
S08-tracks-in-the-ash.md.quote: The heat trail leads from the Bell Gate tower down Kiln Street toward the Old Mine.

S08-tracks-in-the-ash.md.subject: Tamsin
S08-tracks-in-the-ash.md.statement: Tamsin hands Ves a folded message from the Abbey.
S08-tracks-in-the-ash.md.quote: She spots Ves coming off the stair, skids across the wet planks, and presses a folded message into Ves's hand.

S08-tracks-in-the-ash.md.subject: Tamsin
S08-tracks-in-the-ash.md.statement: Tamsin runs back up the stair without waiting for an answer.
S08-tracks-in-the-ash.md.quote: Then she runs back up the stair without waiting for an answer

S08-tracks-in-the-ash.md.subject: Ves
S08-tracks-in-the-ash.md.statement: Ves tests her Ashsight on Kiln Street.
S08-tracks-in-the-ash.md.quote: Ves tests her new sight on Kiln Street, where the lamps are cold and unlit at this hour.

S08-tracks-in-the-ash.md.subject: Ves
S08-tracks-in-the-ash.md.statement: Ves sees fading heat-prints on the cobbles of Kiln Street.
S08-tracks-in-the-ash.md.quote: Ves sees fading heat-prints on the cobbles of Kiln Street, each one a pale ghost of someone who walked there after the last bell.

S08-tracks-in-the-ash.md.subject: Ves
S08-tracks-in-the-ash.md.statement: Ves looks up at the Bell Gate tower.
S08-tracks-in-the-ash.md.quote: Ves looks up at the Bell Gate tower, where the great bell hangs silent above the town.

S08-tracks-in-the-ash.md.subject: Ves
S08-tracks-in-the-ash.md.statement: Ves follows a limping stride through the heat-prints.
S08-tracks-in-the-ash.md.quote: It is a limping stride, one foot pressed harder than the other

S08-tracks-in-the-ash.md.subject: Pass Guard
S08-tracks-in-the-ash.md.statement: A Pass Guard patrol passes the bottom of Kiln Street.
S08-tracks-in-the-ash.md.quote: A Pass Guard patrol passes the bottom of Kiln Street and does not look up.

S09-the-old-mine.md.subject: Ves
S09-the-old-mine.md.statement: Ves opens the sealed door of the Old Mine with the Cinder Key.
S09-the-old-mine.md.quote: Ves turns the Cinder Key and the sealed door of the Old Mine sighs open.

S09-the-old-mine.md.subject: Odo
S09-the-old-mine.md.statement: Odo is at the Old Mine at 22:00 on Day 2.
S09-the-old-mine.md.quote: The sign-in board shows that Odo Fenn was at the Old Mine at 22:00 on Day 2.

S09-the-old-mine.md.subject: Bronze Clapper
S09-the-old-mine.md.statement: The Bronze Clapper is hidden in the Old Mine.
S09-the-old-mine.md.quote: Wrapped in sacking behind the ore carts lies the Bronze Clapper.

S09-the-old-mine.md.subject: Odo
S09-the-old-mine.md.statement: Odo buries the Bronze Clapper under the third lamp on Kiln Street.
S09-the-old-mine.md.quote: Odo buries the bronze clapper beneath the third lamp on Kiln Street.

S09-the-old-mine.md.subject: Ves
S09-the-old-mine.md.statement: Ves is at the Bell Gate at 14:00 on Day 3.
S09-the-old-mine.md.quote: At 14:00 on Day 3, Ves is back at the Bell Gate with the clapper wrapped in her cloak.

S09-the-old-mine.md.subject: Ves
S09-the-old-mine.md.statement: Ves walks into the dark of the Old Mine.
S09-the-old-mine.md.quote: She walks into the dark with the key still warm in her fist.

S09-the-old-mine.md.subject: Ves
S09-the-old-mine.md.statement: Ves uses Ashsight to find the way through the Old Mine.
S09-the-old-mine.md.quote: Ves uses Ashsight to find the way through the Old Mine, where the heat of old footsteps is thick on the floor.

S09-the-old-mine.md.subject: Ves
S09-the-old-mine.md.statement: Ves reads the sign-in board at the junction.
S09-the-old-mine.md.quote: Ves reads the sign-in board at the junction, slowly, because the chalk is faint and some of the names have been smeared by a sleeve.

S09-the-old-mine.md.subject: Ves
S09-the-old-mine.md.statement: Ves carries the Bronze Clapper out of the Old Mine.
S09-the-old-mine.md.quote: She hauls the bundle onto her shoulder and starts back toward the light.

S10-saltgate-at-dusk.md.subject: Ves
S10-saltgate-at-dusk.md.statement: Ves is at Saltgate at 14:10 on Day 3.
S10-saltgate-at-dusk.md.quote: At 14:10 on Day 3, Ves is pushing through the crowd at Saltgate, looking for Ysolde.

S10-saltgate-at-dusk.md.subject: Mother Brisk
S10-saltgate-at-dusk.md.statement: Mother Brisk is at Saltgate around evening on Day 3.
S10-saltgate-at-dusk.md.quote: Around evening on Day 3, Mother Brisk is at Saltgate haggling over a barrel of ember salt.

S10-saltgate-at-dusk.md.subject: Ves
S10-saltgate-at-dusk.md.statement: Ves stops at the mule-carts' rope in Saltgate and waits.
S10-saltgate-at-dusk.md.quote: Ves stops at the rope where the mule-carts are queued.

S10-saltgate-at-dusk.md.subject: Mother Brisk
S10-saltgate-at-dusk.md.statement: Mother Brisk pays half the asking price for a barrel of ember salt.
S10-saltgate-at-dusk.md.quote: Mother Brisk taps the lid twice, pays half of what he asks, and waves a boy over to roll the barrel toward the back door of the Kettle & Coal.

S10-saltgate-at-dusk.md.subject: Ves
S10-saltgate-at-dusk.md.statement: Ves cannot decide whether Ysolde's night runs are a comfort or a warning.
S10-saltgate-at-dusk.md.quote: Ves has known that for years, and she has never been able to decide whether it is a comfort or a warning.

S10-saltgate-at-dusk.md.subject: Ysolde
S10-saltgate-at-dusk.md.statement: Ysolde steps back into the alley and vanishes before Ves can reach her.
S10-saltgate-at-dusk.md.quote: She steps back into the dark of the alley, and the crowd closes over the place where she stood.

S10-saltgate-at-dusk.md.subject: Ysolde
S10-saltgate-at-dusk.md.statement: Ysolde does not return Ves's greeting in the square.
S10-saltgate-at-dusk.md.quote: Ves lifts a hand. Ysolde does not lift hers.

S10-saltgate-at-dusk.md.subject: Ysolde
S10-saltgate-at-dusk.md.statement: Ysolde's mules leave Saltgate by the lower gate in a single line.
S10-saltgate-at-dusk.md.quote: Ysolde's mules are moving now, the packs roped down, the drivers pulling the lead animals into a line toward the lower gate.

S10-saltgate-at-dusk.md.subject: Red Mule Caravan
S10-saltgate-at-dusk.md.statement: The Red Mule Caravan burns its brand into every pack saddle.
S10-saltgate-at-dusk.md.quote: The Red Mule brand is burned into every pack saddle, and Ves knows it the way she knows her own handwriting.

S10-saltgate-at-dusk.md.subject: Ves
S10-saltgate-at-dusk.md.statement: Ves keeps her distance from Mother Brisk at the market stalls.
S10-saltgate-at-dusk.md.quote: Ves watches from the far side of the stalls and does not go over.

S11-the-dawn-bell.md.subject: Ves
S11-the-dawn-bell.md.statement: Ves rings the Ashbell at 06:00 on Day 4.
S11-the-dawn-bell.md.quote: At 06:00 on Day 4, Ves rings the Ashbell herself, and the sound rolls all the way down to the Foot of the Pass.

S11-the-dawn-bell.md.subject: Ves
S11-the-dawn-bell.md.statement: Ves helps Corin rehang the Bronze Clapper in the dark.
S11-the-dawn-bell.md.quote: Ves and Corin lift the Bronze Clapper back onto its hook in the dark, and neither of them says much.

S11-the-dawn-bell.md.subject: Corin
S11-the-dawn-bell.md.statement: Corin falls on the tower stair and breaks his arm.
S11-the-dawn-bell.md.quote: Corin falls on the stone stair of the tower and breaks his arm.

S11-the-dawn-bell.md.subject: Ves
S11-the-dawn-bell.md.statement: Ves splints Corin's arm with two slats from a broken crate.
S11-the-dawn-bell.md.quote: Ves wraps the arm in her own scarf and splints it with two slats from a broken crate that someone left on the landing.

S11-the-dawn-bell.md.subject: Corin
S11-the-dawn-bell.md.statement: Corin props his broken arm against the wall and says nothing.
S11-the-dawn-bell.md.quote: Corin props his broken arm against the wall and says nothing.

S11-the-dawn-bell.md.subject: Ves
S11-the-dawn-bell.md.statement: Ves pulls the rope with both hands and leans her weight into it.
S11-the-dawn-bell.md.quote: Ves pulls the rope with both hands and leans her weight into it.

S11-the-dawn-bell.md.subject: Ves
S11-the-dawn-bell.md.statement: Ves loses her voice in the middle of a breath.
S11-the-dawn-bell.md.quote: Her voice goes out in the middle of a breath, and she tastes iron.

S11-the-dawn-bell.md.subject: Corin
S11-the-dawn-bell.md.statement: Corin holds Ves by the shoulder with his good hand.
S11-the-dawn-bell.md.quote: Corin holds Ves by the shoulder with his good hand and does not let go

S11-the-dawn-bell.md.subject: Corin
S11-the-dawn-bell.md.statement: Corin knows what ringing the bell costs the ringer.
S11-the-dawn-bell.md.quote: Corin's face shows that he knows the price of the rope.

S12-the-broken-oath.md.subject: Ysolde
S12-the-broken-oath.md.statement: Corin is Ysolde's sworn partner at 08:00 on Day 4.
S12-the-broken-oath.md.quote: At 08:00 on Day 4, Ysolde's sworn partner, Corin, meets her at the foot of the Bell Gate stairs.

S12-the-broken-oath.md.subject: Ysolde
S12-the-broken-oath.md.statement: Ysolde paid Odo to steal the Bronze Clapper.
S12-the-broken-oath.md.quote: Ysolde admits she paid Odo Fenn to take the Bronze Clapper.

S12-the-broken-oath.md.subject: Ysolde
S12-the-broken-oath.md.statement: Ysolde wanted the Cinder Bridge open after dusk for one ember-salt run.
S12-the-broken-oath.md.quote: She wanted the Cinder Bridge open after dusk for one run, and she wanted it without asking.

S12-the-broken-oath.md.subject: Odo
S12-the-broken-oath.md.statement: Odo accepts Ysolde's coin and does the rest of the job.
S12-the-broken-oath.md.quote: Her coin went to Odo, and Odo did the rest.

S12-the-broken-oath.md.subject: Corin
S12-the-broken-oath.md.statement: Corin waits for Ysolde to finish without shouting at her.
S12-the-broken-oath.md.quote: Corin does not shout. He stands very still, the splinted arm held against his ribs, and he waits for her to finish.

S12-the-broken-oath.md.subject: Ves
S12-the-broken-oath.md.statement: Ves writes her question on a slate because she has no voice.
S12-the-broken-oath.md.quote: Ves writes on a slate with a stub of chalk, pressing so hard that the chalk squeaks.

S12-the-broken-oath.md.subject: Ves
S12-the-broken-oath.md.statement: Ves turns her slate toward Corin so he can read the question.
S12-the-broken-oath.md.quote: She turns the slate so Corin can read it, and his jaw tightens.

S12-the-broken-oath.md.subject: Corin
S12-the-broken-oath.md.statement: Corin sits down on the lowest step of the Bell Gate stairs.
S12-the-broken-oath.md.quote: Corin sits down on the lowest step of the Bell Gate stairs without being asked.

S12-the-broken-oath.md.subject: Ysolde
S12-the-broken-oath.md.statement: Ysolde says she did it for the Red Mule Caravan and its salt.
S12-the-broken-oath.md.quote: She did it, she says, for the caravan, and for the salt that feeds the lower town through winter.

S13-voiceless.md.subject: Ves
S13-voiceless.md.statement: Ves still cannot speak at noon on Day 4 after ringing the Ashbell.
S13-voiceless.md.quote: At noon on Day 4, Ves still cannot speak a single word.

S13-voiceless.md.subject: Odo
S13-voiceless.md.statement: Odo Fenn confesses to Ves in the bell tower.
S13-voiceless.md.quote: Half this town calls me the Lamplighter

S13-voiceless.md.subject: Odo
S13-voiceless.md.statement: Odo Fenn took the Bronze Clapper down from the Ashbell.
S13-voiceless.md.quote: I took it down from the Ashbell myself.

S13-voiceless.md.subject: Odo
S13-voiceless.md.statement: Odo Fenn owes money to Ysolde Marr.
S13-voiceless.md.quote: I owe Ysolde Marr more than a lamplighter earns in a lifetime.

S13-voiceless.md.subject: Odo
S13-voiceless.md.statement: Odo Fenn swore he was on the Cinder Bridge on the night the clapper was taken.
S13-voiceless.md.quote: I swore to Captain Rourke that I was on the Cinder Bridge that night, and I was not.

S13-voiceless.md.subject: Rourke
S13-voiceless.md.statement: Rourke left his post to drink at the Kettle & Coal.
S13-voiceless.md.quote: I left my post to drink at the Kettle & Coal, and I'm ashamed of it.

S13-voiceless.md.subject: Hesper
S13-voiceless.md.statement: Abbess Hesper Quill comes to the Bell Gate, carried in a chair.
S13-voiceless.md.quote: Abbess Hesper Quill sits in the chair with a blanket over her knees

S13-voiceless.md.subject: Hesper
S13-voiceless.md.statement: Hesper tells Ves that ringing the bell was her own choice.
S13-voiceless.md.quote: Ringing it was your own choice, and that matters more than the voice.

S13-voiceless.md.subject: Ysolde
S13-voiceless.md.statement: The town will hear Ysolde Marr at Saltgate over her broken oath.
S13-voiceless.md.quote: The town will hear Ysolde Marr at Saltgate

S13-voiceless.md.subject: Mother Brisk
S13-voiceless.md.statement: Mother Brisk gives Ves a slate and chalk at breakfast.
S13-voiceless.md.quote: Mother Brisk pressed a slate into her hands at breakfast

S14-the-long-road-down.md.subject: Ves
S14-the-long-road-down.md.statement: Ves visits Stillfire Abbey on Day 5.
S14-the-long-road-down.md.quote: On Day 5, Ves climbs to Stillfire Abbey to return the Cinder Key.

S14-the-long-road-down.md.subject: Ves
S14-the-long-road-down.md.statement: Ves is at the Bell Gate at 10:00 on Day 5.
S14-the-long-road-down.md.quote: At 10:00 on Day 5, Ves stands at the Bell Gate and watches the Red Mule Caravan go.

S14-the-long-road-down.md.subject: Ves
S14-the-long-road-down.md.statement: Ves speaks again at sunrise on Day 5.
S14-the-long-road-down.md.quote: It comes out rough and cracked, like a hinge nobody has oiled in years, but it is hers.

S14-the-long-road-down.md.subject: Hesper
S14-the-long-road-down.md.statement: Hesper takes the Cinder Key back from Ves at the Ember Well.
S14-the-long-road-down.md.quote: Ves places the key in it, and the old woman closes her fingers over it without ceremony.

S14-the-long-road-down.md.subject: Hesper
S14-the-long-road-down.md.statement: Hesper tells Ves she will not need her again.
S14-the-long-road-down.md.quote: You will not need me again, and that is the best thing I can say to anyone who has walked this road.

S14-the-long-road-down.md.subject: Corin
S14-the-long-road-down.md.statement: Corin stands beside Ves at the Bell Gate with his arm in a sling.
S14-the-long-road-down.md.quote: Corin stands beside her with his arm in a sling and says nothing, which is his way of saying a great deal.

S14-the-long-road-down.md.subject: Red Mule Caravan
S14-the-long-road-down.md.statement: The Red Mule Caravan leaves Kettlehold through the Bell Gate.
S14-the-long-road-down.md.quote: The wagons roll out under the gate one by one, their wheels loud on the stones

S14-the-long-road-down.md.subject: Ysolde
S14-the-long-road-down.md.statement: Ysolde Marr rides at the front of the departing caravan.
S14-the-long-road-down.md.quote: Ysolde Marr rides at the front and does not look back

S14-the-long-road-down.md.subject: Bronze Clapper
S14-the-long-road-down.md.statement: The Bronze Clapper is back in place on the day the caravan leaves.
S14-the-long-road-down.md.quote: The clapper is back in place

quest-the-silent-bell.md.subject: The Silent Bell
quest-the-silent-bell.md.statement: The Silent Bell quest is given by Corin.
quest-the-silent-bell.md.quote: The Silent Bell is given by Corin when the dusk bell fails on Day 2.

quest-the-silent-bell.md.subject: The Silent Bell
quest-the-silent-bell.md.statement: The Silent Bell is the main quest of Act 2.
quest-the-silent-bell.md.quote: The Silent Bell is the main quest of Act 2 and cannot be skipped.

quest-the-silent-bell.md.subject: Rourke
quest-the-silent-bell.md.statement: Rourke swears nobody went up the tower stair on the night the bell failed.
quest-the-silent-bell.md.quote: He stood watch at the Bell Gate that night and swears nobody went up the tower stair.

quest-the-silent-bell.md.subject: Corin
quest-the-silent-bell.md.statement: Corin trusts Ves to look into the silent bell without taking a side.
quest-the-silent-bell.md.quote: He asks Ves because she knows the caravan roads, the people who use them, and how to look at a thing without taking a side.

quest-the-silent-bell.md.subject: Bronze Clapper
quest-the-silent-bell.md.statement: The Bronze Clapper is hidden in the Old Mine, wrapped in sacking.
quest-the-silent-bell.md.quote: The Bronze Clapper is here too, wrapped in sacking.

quest-the-silent-bell.md.subject: Ashsight
quest-the-silent-bell.md.statement: Ashsight reveals the warm prints of a single person leaving the road.
quest-the-silent-bell.md.quote: With Ashsight, the warm prints of one person show on the stones, leaving the road and heading toward the gorge.

quest-the-silent-bell.md.subject: Cinder Key
quest-the-silent-bell.md.statement: The Cinder Key opens the Order seal on the Old Mine.
quest-the-silent-bell.md.quote: The Cinder Key opens the Order's seal.

quest-the-silent-bell.md.subject: Odo
quest-the-silent-bell.md.statement: Odo Fenn signed the sign-in board at the Old Mine.

quest-the-silent-bell.md.subject: Ysolde
quest-the-silent-bell.md.statement: Ysolde offers Ves a share of the ember-salt run to keep quiet.
quest-the-silent-bell.md.quote: Ysolde talks more freely there, and she offers Ves a share of the ember-salt run to keep quiet.

quest-a-debt-in-salt.md.subject: Odo
quest-a-debt-in-salt.md.statement: Odo Fenn owes Ysolde forty silver marks.
quest-a-debt-in-salt.md.quote: Odo Fenn owes Ysolde forty silver marks from a bad winter at the Foot of the Pass.

quest-a-debt-in-salt.md.subject: A Debt in Salt
quest-a-debt-in-salt.md.statement: A Debt in Salt is given by Mother Brisk.
quest-a-debt-in-salt.md.quote: A Debt in Salt is given by Mother Brisk once the player has eaten at the Kettle & Coal.

quest-a-debt-in-salt.md.subject: Mother Brisk
quest-a-debt-in-salt.md.statement: Mother Brisk feeds every caravan that rides into Kettlehold.
quest-a-debt-in-salt.md.quote: She feeds every caravan that rides into Kettlehold, and she hears everything said over her tables.

quest-a-debt-in-salt.md.subject: Odo
quest-a-debt-in-salt.md.statement: Odo keeps a tally of every coin he borrows.
quest-a-debt-in-salt.md.quote: Odo keeps the tally of every lamp he lights and every coin he borrows, and he has not forgotten a single mark.

quest-a-debt-in-salt.md.subject: Ysolde
quest-a-debt-in-salt.md.statement: Ysolde smuggles ember salt for the Red Mule Caravan.
quest-a-debt-in-salt.md.quote: The caravan's smuggling of ember salt comes out in that scene, and Ysolde will not forgive the player for it.

quest-a-debt-in-salt.md.subject: Odo
quest-a-debt-in-salt.md.statement: Odo keeps his post on Kiln Street as the town lamplighter.
quest-a-debt-in-salt.md.quote: Odo is at his post on Kiln Street, polishing a lamp glass that does not need it.

quest-a-debt-in-salt.md.subject: Mother Brisk
quest-a-debt-in-salt.md.statement: Mother Brisk wants Odo to go home before he drinks what little he has left.
quest-a-debt-in-salt.md.quote: She says that Odo has been sitting at the back of her bar for three nights, and that she would like him to go home before he drinks what little he has left.

quest-a-debt-in-salt.md.subject: Ysolde
quest-a-debt-in-salt.md.statement: Ysolde holds Odo debt and waits to collect it.
quest-a-debt-in-salt.md.quote: Ysolde has not forgotten either, and she is patient in the way that only a caravan captain can afford to be.

quest-a-debt-in-salt.md.subject: Rourke
quest-a-debt-in-salt.md.statement: Rourke reads the Pass Guard's notes aloud at the next muster.
quest-a-debt-in-salt.md.quote: Exposing Ysolde adds a line to the Pass Guard's notes, which Rourke reads aloud at the next muster.

quest-the-well-before-dawn.md.subject: Tamsin
quest-the-well-before-dawn.md.statement: Tamsin is at Stillfire Abbey at 09:12 on Day 3.
quest-the-well-before-dawn.md.quote: At 09:12 on Day 3, Tamsin is at the gate of Stillfire Abbey, out of breath.

quest-the-well-before-dawn.md.subject: The Well Before Dawn
quest-the-well-before-dawn.md.statement: The Well Before Dawn rewards the player with Ashsight.
quest-the-well-before-dawn.md.quote: The Well Before Dawn rewards the player with Ashsight.

quest-the-well-before-dawn.md.subject: Hesper
quest-the-well-before-dawn.md.statement: Hesper asks Ves what she is willing to give up to see clearly.
quest-the-well-before-dawn.md.quote: She asks Ves what she is willing to give up to see clearly.

quest-the-well-before-dawn.md.subject: Hesper
quest-the-well-before-dawn.md.statement: Hesper repeats her drink-before-dawn rule to Ves twice.
quest-the-well-before-dawn.md.quote: Hesper's rule is simple, and she repeats it twice in case the player missed it the first time.

quest-the-well-before-dawn.md.subject: Cinder Key
quest-the-well-before-dawn.md.statement: The Cinder Key is loaned by the Order of the Quiet Flame.
quest-the-well-before-dawn.md.quote: The Order also gives Ves the Cinder Key, a warm iron key that opens doors sealed by the Order, and Hesper says it is a loan, not a gift.

quest-the-well-before-dawn.md.subject: Ashsight
quest-the-well-before-dawn.md.statement: Ashsight shows heat left by footsteps for about a day.
quest-the-well-before-dawn.md.quote: The player sees heat left by footsteps for the first time, and the view stays for about a day.

quest-the-well-before-dawn.md.subject: Tamsin
quest-the-well-before-dawn.md.statement: Tamsin carries messages to Stillfire Abbey.
quest-the-well-before-dawn.md.quote: Tamsin appears in the middle of this run as the courier who carries messages between the town and the Abbey.

quest-the-well-before-dawn.md.subject: Ember Well
quest-the-well-before-dawn.md.statement: The Ember Well stands in the Abbey lower cloister, where the water steams.
quest-the-well-before-dawn.md.quote: The Ember Well sits in the lower cloister of Stillfire Abbey, and its water grants Ashsight to anyone who drinks before the sky turns grey.

dlg-town-crier.md.subject: Mother Brisk
dlg-town-crier.md.statement: Mother Brisk is at the Salt Gate from 07:00 to 08:00 on Day 4.
dlg-town-crier.md.quote: From 07:00 to 08:00 on Day 4, Mother Brisk is at the Salt Gate buying salt for the inn.

dlg-town-crier.md.subject: Red Mule Caravan
dlg-town-crier.md.statement: The Red Mule Caravan is back in Kettlehold with lamp oil and salt.
dlg-town-crier.md.quote: The Red Mule Caravan is back in Kettlehold, and its wagons are loaded with lamp oil and salt.

dlg-town-crier.md.subject: Ves
dlg-town-crier.md.statement: Ves Calloway rides through the Bell Gate after six years away.
dlg-town-crier.md.quote: Ves Calloway has ridden through the Bell Gate after six years away.

dlg-town-crier.md.subject: Pass Guard
dlg-town-crier.md.statement: The Pass Guard walks people home after curfew.
dlg-town-crier.md.quote: the Pass Guard will walk you home whether you like the walk or not.

dlg-town-crier.md.subject: Kettlehold
dlg-town-crier.md.statement: Kettlehold keeps its curfew at dusk.
dlg-town-crier.md.quote: Curfew is at dusk, as it always is.

dlg-town-crier.md.subject: Kiln Street
dlg-town-crier.md.statement: Lamps on Kiln Street must be kept lit after dark.
dlg-town-crier.md.quote: Keep your lamps lit on Kiln Street.

dlg-town-crier.md.subject: Rourke
dlg-town-crier.md.statement: Captain Rourke claims he watched the Bell Gate tower all night.
dlg-town-crier.md.quote: Captain Rourke swears he watched the tower all through the dark

dlg-town-crier.md.subject: Odo
dlg-town-crier.md.statement: Odo Fenn claims he was on the Cinder Bridge.
dlg-town-crier.md.quote: Odo Fenn swears he was on the bridge.

dlg-town-crier.md.subject: Hesper
dlg-town-crier.md.statement: Abbess Hesper has closed the Ember Well to visitors.
dlg-town-crier.md.quote: Abbess Hesper sent word down the stair that the Ember Well is closed to visitors, except by her own word.

dlg-town-crier.md.subject: Kettle & Coal
dlg-town-crier.md.statement: Cheap cider is poured at the back of the Kettle & Coal.
dlg-town-crier.md.quote: the cheap cider at the back of the Kettle & Coal

dlg-ysolde-and-corin.md.subject: Corin
dlg-ysolde-and-corin.md.statement: Corin refuses to keep the Cinder Bridge open after the bell.
dlg-ysolde-and-corin.md.quote: CORIN: The bridge closes when the bell rings. It always has.

dlg-ysolde-and-corin.md.subject: Ysolde
dlg-ysolde-and-corin.md.statement: Ysolde renounces her oath to Corin.
dlg-ysolde-and-corin.md.quote: YSOLDE: Then I'm done with oaths -- yours and mine.

dlg-ysolde-and-corin.md.subject: Corin
dlg-ysolde-and-corin.md.statement: Corin says his father Aldous never asked the bridge to wait.
dlg-ysolde-and-corin.md.quote: My father rang that bell with his last breath, and he never once asked the bridge to wait for anyone.

dlg-ysolde-and-corin.md.subject: Ysolde
dlg-ysolde-and-corin.md.statement: Ysolde and Corin once made an oath together on the bell.
dlg-ysolde-and-corin.md.quote: We made our oath on the same bell, you and I

dlg-ysolde-and-corin.md.subject: Ysolde
dlg-ysolde-and-corin.md.statement: Ysolde asks Corin to leave the bridge open for one night.
dlg-ysolde-and-corin.md.quote: Just once, Corin. Leave the bridge open for one night and I will never ask again.

dlg-ysolde-and-corin.md.subject: Ysolde
dlg-ysolde-and-corin.md.statement: Ysolde has a caravan of ember salt waiting at the Foot of the Pass.
dlg-ysolde-and-corin.md.quote: I have a caravan of ember salt waiting at the Foot of the Pass

dlg-ysolde-and-corin.md.subject: Corin
dlg-ysolde-and-corin.md.statement: Corin says he will not open the bridge for salt or love.
dlg-ysolde-and-corin.md.quote: I will not open the bridge for salt or for love.

dlg-ysolde-and-corin.md.subject: Ysolde
dlg-ysolde-and-corin.md.statement: Ysolde warns Corin that a broken oath will cost the town.
dlg-ysolde-and-corin.md.quote: Then you will see what a broken oath costs this town, and you will be the one who pays it.

dlg-ysolde-and-corin.md.subject: Pass Guard
dlg-ysolde-and-corin.md.statement: The Pass Guard stands by while Ysolde and Corin argue.
dlg-ysolde-and-corin.md.quote: The Pass Guard shifts his feet and looks at the gravel.

dlg-ysolde-and-corin.md.subject: Ysolde
dlg-ysolde-and-corin.md.statement: Ysolde says Odo owes her money.
dlg-ysolde-and-corin.md.quote: Odo owes me, and he will pay me one way or another.

dlg-tamsin-on-the-road.md.subject: Tamsin
dlg-tamsin-on-the-road.md.quote: "Out here you're my sister of the road," Tamsin tells Ves, though they share no blood at all.

dlg-tamsin-on-the-road.md.subject: Tamsin
dlg-tamsin-on-the-road.md.statement: Tamsin carries letters up to Stillfire Abbey for half of Kettlehold.
dlg-tamsin-on-the-road.md.quote: I carry letters up to the Abbey for half the town, and I have never once been late.

dlg-tamsin-on-the-road.md.subject: Hesper
dlg-tamsin-on-the-road.md.statement: Abbess Hesper gives Tamsin a sweet from the jar on her desk.
dlg-tamsin-on-the-road.md.quote: She gave me a sweet from the jar on her desk and said I had good legs for stairs.

dlg-tamsin-on-the-road.md.subject: Tamsin
dlg-tamsin-on-the-road.md.statement: Tamsin notes that Ves has been gone six years.
dlg-tamsin-on-the-road.md.quote: You have been gone six years, Ves.

dlg-tamsin-on-the-road.md.subject: Ves
dlg-tamsin-on-the-road.md.statement: Ves left Kettlehold six years ago.
dlg-tamsin-on-the-road.md.quote: I was a kid with scraped knees when you left

dlg-tamsin-on-the-road.md.subject: Tamsin
dlg-tamsin-on-the-road.md.statement: Tamsin wants to sign on with the Red Mule Caravan.
dlg-tamsin-on-the-road.md.quote: I would sign on with the Red Mule tomorrow if Ysolde would have me.

dlg-tamsin-on-the-road.md.subject: Ember Well
dlg-tamsin-on-the-road.md.statement: Rumour at the Abbey gate says the Ember Well is haunted.
dlg-tamsin-on-the-road.md.quote: Everyone at the Abbey gate says the Ember Well is haunted now.

dlg-tamsin-on-the-road.md.subject: Tamsin
dlg-tamsin-on-the-road.md.statement: Tamsin trusts Ves with her letters.
dlg-tamsin-on-the-road.md.quote: I trust you with my letters, and that is more than I trust most of the town.

dlg-tamsin-on-the-road.md.subject: Tamsin
dlg-tamsin-on-the-road.md.statement: Tamsin crossed the Cinder Bridge early this morning.
dlg-tamsin-on-the-road.md.quote: I crossed it this morning before the sun was up.
